author: David Bombal
description:
Why does this factory robot run its AI on board? I asked Jarad Cannon, CTO of Humanoid, what happens when a whole fleet of robots needs to make decisions at once.

Jarad walks me through the Alpha prototype. One AI model helps the robot decide what to do. A second turns that plan into movement. Training happens mostly in the cloud, but each robot runs the models on board using NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin. That way, a fleet can work on the same factory floor without sending every decision to the cloud.

Thank you to NVIDIA for sponsoring this video and my trip to NVIDIA GTC in Berlin.

#Robotics #EdgeAI #NVIDIA
title: Why This Robot Runs Its AI on Board
